# sprint github links create

## Help

```text
NAME
  sprint github links create — GitHub App connection or explicit mapping through authenticated HTTP; current project authority is rechecked.

SYNOPSIS
  sprint github links create --json-data OBJECT | --file PATH --operation-key KEY [FLAGS]

DESCRIPTION
  GitHub App connection or explicit mapping through authenticated HTTP; current project authority is rechecked.

EXAMPLES
  sprint github links create --file input.json --operation-key KEY

POSITIONAL ARGUMENTS
  None; see SYNOPSIS for required input flags.

FLAGS
  --expected-revision REVISION (existing link changes)
  --operation-key KEY (required; see SYNOPSIS)
  --non-interactive
  --json-data OBJECT | --file PATH

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                 Show command help without authentication or network.
  --schema [DOMAIN]          Print API action contracts as JSON; not CLI flag syntax.
  --llms [DOMAIN]            AI guide; DOMAIN selects action-contract JSON.
  --profile NAME             Select a private Sprint profile (default: default).
  --token-file FILE          Use an owned mode 0600 automation-token JSON file.
  --non-interactive          Never prompt; startup auto-update is skipped.
  --wait                     Observe an accepted job without retrying the mutation.
  --timeout SECONDS          Wait timeout, 1..3600; requires --wait (default: 30).

OUTPUT
  output data on stdout; errors on stderr.

AUTHENTICATION
  Sprint profile or automation-token file required. Server permissions are authoritative.

NOTES
  Examples use placeholder IDs and files; replace them with authorized current values.
  Optional --expected-revision STRING forwards If-Match unchanged for native resource update/delete, comment update/delete and relation delete only. Use the current DTO _revision; 1..256 visible ASCII characters (no whitespace or controls). Omission preserves unconditional behavior for legacy JSON/file-only commands; daily-flag issue updates first read the authorized issue revision once; a stale revision fails without automatic retry or fallback. Not supported for create/add/list/get/iterate.
```
